projects.title: Arbor
projects.tagline: A canvas for brainstorming with branching LLM chats.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Arbor is a canvas where each LLM chat is a block. You can branch a new chat from any message, fork threads, and draw links between related ideas, instead of scrolling through one long thread.

sections.title: Features
items: Branch a new chat from any message

sections.title: Technical Details
sections.content: Built with Next.js and TypeScript, using React Flow for the canvas, OpenAI's API for the chats, and Supabase with Prisma for storage.

projects.title: Amelia
projects.tagline: A hackathon assistant for air traffic controllers that flags risky flights and talks to pilots in standard FAA phraseology.

sections.title: The Problem
sections.content: Air traffic control is understaffed, which contributes to delays and safety incidents. Training a new controller takes years, so the shortage can't be fixed quickly.

sections.title: Our Solution
sections.content: Amelia pulls in live flight and weather data, flags risks for flights within 40 nautical miles, and talks to pilots through a synthesized voice using standard FAA phraseology. It's meant to assist the controller.

sections.title: Features
items: Risk flags from live flight and weather data
Voice synthesis for calls to pilots
Uses scraped NTSB accident and incident reports
